description.value: The Wicklow is a cozy waterfront tavern at Stamps Landing overlooking False Creek, serving food made fresh in house daily alongside a full drinks menu and happy hour specials. Situated along a popular cycling corridor near the False Creek seawall, the pub offers a patio with stunning water views. It operates as a neighbourhood pub with table reservations available for larger parties.
